We deserve fair representation. We deserve lawful maps, not racial gerrymanders. We deserve our elections to fulfill the promise of our democracy, not be stuck at the whim of a feckless Supreme Court pursuing a partisan agenda to codify racial voter suppression.
Help us fight for fair maps, fair elections, and fairly counted votes across the country by rushing $25 or more right now >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=082124_3&amount=25]
Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=082124_3&amount=25]
NYT: Supreme Court Sides With Republicans Over South Carolina Voting Map [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=082124_3&amount=25]
We expected this, Team, even if it's bad news: The Supreme Court ruled 6-3 along party lines to overrule a panel of three federal judges that had previously ruled that South Carolina's 1st Congressional District was unlawfully drawn as a racial gerrymander.
A unanimous three-judge panel of the Federal District Court in Columbia, S.C., ruled in early 2023 that " the state’s First Congressional District, drawn after the 2020 census, violated the Constitution by making race the predominant factor ".
Voters in South Carolina were already going to be forced to vote in racially gerrymandered districts in 2024 because the Supreme Court dragged their feet deciding this case. Now these racially gerrymandered districts are law , courtesy of a Supreme Court hellbent on dismantling voting rights and fair representation nationwide.
This is Court-sanctioned voter suppression by way of gerrymandering, Team, plain and simple. Help us fight back against opponents of voting rights nationwide by pitching in $25 or whatever you can today >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=082124_3&amount=25]

subject: Build Alaska's Future: New Projects, Partners, and Branding
body:
As founding board members of Build Alaska's Future (BAF), it is our privilege to share our new look and updated plan with you and ask for your help to achieve our ambitious goals, whether you live in Alaska or not.| | |
---
| | Dear Friend, **As founding board members of[Build Alaska's Future](https://click.everyaction.com/k/91275441/493304323/-1512324198?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzEwMjc1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmZmM5NDQyNi0xYjYwLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=X0dPJgITDb3FWNu1eShaGeVWg0flCoGP08MS9GK8cpY=&emci=401ca97d-e75f-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=ffc94426-1b60-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=9512399) (BAF), we are proud to display our updated branding, announce new projects, and to ask for your help to achieve our ambitious goals.** At BAF, we believe that education cultivates public trust in government and other crucial institutions, and trust creates stronger communities. By helping every Alaskan stay informed, we hope to foster empowered and engaged communities across the state. Here’s how we’re doing all that: **Our** **first-of-its-kind, state-level[federal funding map](https://click.everyaction.com/k/91275442/493304324/1280965991?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzEwMjc1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmZmM5NDQyNi0xYjYwLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=X0dPJgITDb3FWNu1eShaGeVWg0flCoGP08MS9GK8cpY=&emci=401ca97d-e75f-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=ffc94426-1b60-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=9512399)** **helps Alaskans to explore over 4,000 federally funded projects across the state,** including descriptions, categories, and funding amounts that describe how these projects will affect everyday lives. **Right now, our team is working on major improvements to this map aimed at empowering communities.** The improvements will include ground level views of federal projects and more precise geo-locators. These will allow Alaskans to see which projects are not just in their community but in their neighborhood, starting with South Central, Southeast, and Interior Alaska. You can find our map [here](https://click.everyaction.com/k/91275443/493304325/2108661445?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzEwMjc1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmZmM5NDQyNi0xYjYwLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=X0dPJgITDb3FWNu1eShaGeVWg0flCoGP08MS9GK8cpY=&emci=401ca97d-e75f-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=ffc94426-1b60-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=9512399) on our website, where you can also see our fresh new branding. **BAF has forged new and important partnerships with organizations like iHeart Media, Labor, Rural CAP, and the Alaska Municipal League.** Our partner organizations collaborate with us on initiatives like the state-level federal funding map, the Alaska Native Workforce Development Workshop, and the Alaska Governance Project. Together, we amplify our voices so we can reach more Alaskans. **Build Alaska's Future invites you to partner with us to tell the story of the opportunities that historic federal infrastructure investment in recent years represent.** This tax-deductible educational nonprofit accepts grants and donations for public education. Your support enables us to challenge political extremism, foster transparency and trust, and back thoughtful leaders dedicated to our state’s advancement. Together, we can champion Alaska’s legacy of bipartisan collaboration and create a positive, lasting impact for generations to come. **To invest in our work, visit our updated website at[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/91275444/493304327/-1512324198?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzEwMjc1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmZmM5NDQyNi0xYjYwLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=X0dPJgITDb3FWNu1eShaGeVWg0flCoGP08MS9GK8cpY=&emci=401ca97d-e75f-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=ffc94426-1b60-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=9512399)[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/91275445/493304328/-1512324198?fbclid=IwY2xjawEWQzdleHRuA2FlbQIxMQABHe289jVDrB55Ivgd3GpQ6i4MWQDZ3g0X7x4ZgM67kaM-vUr-c9Db93g1vw_aem_kSv620sZtSi5K68yTd9_nw&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzEwMjc1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmZmM5NDQyNi0xYjYwLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=X0dPJgITDb3FWNu1eShaGeVWg0flCoGP08MS9GK8cpY=&emci=401ca97d-e75f-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=ffc94426-1b60-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=9512399)[BuildAlaska.org](https://click.everyaction.com/k/91275447/493304329/-1512324198?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzEwMjc1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmZmM5NDQyNi0xYjYwLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=X0dPJgITDb3FWNu1eShaGeVWg0flCoGP08MS9GK8cpY=&emci=401ca97d-e75f-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=ffc94426-1b60-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=9512399) or contact us at [info@buildAlaska.org](mailto:info@buildAlaska.org "info@buildAlaska.org"). Invest in Alaska’s future!** We invite you to review the prospectus [here](https://click.everyaction.com/k/91275448/493304330/-976422359?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzEwMjc1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmZmM5NDQyNi0xYjYwLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=X0dPJgITDb3FWNu1eShaGeVWg0flCoGP08MS9GK8cpY=&emci=401ca97d-e75f-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=ffc94426-1b60-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=9512399) and contact us directly to discuss your organization and how we can work together. Best regards, David Guttenberg (Fairbanks) and Veronica Slajer (Anchorage)

name: Jill Stein
subject: Did AIPAC write this?!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jill Stein for President 2024
body:
| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=dnc_platform&n=1)
---
Peter,

The Democrats released their official party platform this week – 92 pages of empty rhetoric that is exactly as absurd as you would expect.

I will have a great deal to say about their symbolic climate policies or their marginal economic “fixes” that expand the wealth and power of this country’s donor class.

But first we need to talk about the three full pages they dedicated to Israel.

Ryan Grim of Drop Site News said **“it reads as if AIPAC wrote it.”** From our campaign’s perspective and for everyone who cares about justice for Palestine and ending this genocide, **it reads like a love letter to Bibi Netanyahu.

** The Democrats’ official platform promises Israel:
* **Ongoing, unconditional military aid** and an official reassertion of “Israel’s right to defend itself” (a right they don’t extend to Palestinians).

* Vague support for **ceasefire conditions that are entirely at Israel’s discretion** , allowing them to continue the slaughter in Gaza (and the West Bank) until THEY decide they’ve killed enough.

* **Continued diplomatic cover for Israel’s apartheid regime** with a pledge to “oppose any effort” to criticize or “delegitimize Israel,” including UN sanctions and the BDS movement.

The Democrats don’t stop with giving Israel everything they could dream of. The platform also **recklessly stokes the flames of a broader regional war** by legitimizing Israel’s attacks against Iran, Lebanon, and Yemen – one that could easily set off a _third_ world war.

**This isn’t a platform. It’s a time bomb.

** Ours is the only campaign with a path to the White House that will **end the genocide in Gaza** and pursue an immediate arms embargo and permanent ceasefire with **justice for Palestine**. The only campaign **confronting the climate emergency** with the urgency it demands. And the only campaign with a **radically transformative economic vision** to build a society free of injustice, inequity, hunger, and want – none of which is reflected in the Democrats’ priorities.

**[We have 76 days to deliver our mandate for people, planet, and peace at the ballot box – and we have a LOT of ground to cover. Will you join forces with Butch and me with a contribution of $25, $50, $100 or more today?](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=dnc_platform&n=2)**
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=dnc_platform&n=3 "DONATE NOW") [DONATE NOW](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=dnc_platform&n=3)
---
Gaza may have slipped from the headlines in the wake of all the Harris hype, but the slaughter there has continued unabated.

This week the official death toll topped 40,000 – but we know the real number is likely in the hundreds of thousands.

**All of Gaza has been reduced to rubble. Israel has deliberately targeted homes, schools, water and power infrastructure, hospitals and first responders – they even bombed the tents. Entire families have been wiped out. History is being erased before our very eyes.

** Israel intends to kill their way to “peace” using American bombs. As your president I will immediately halt ALL military aid to Israel on DAY ONE.

Only when we eliminate Israel’s power to continue indiscriminate mass murder, torture, detention, and apartheid can we hope to work towards peace and justice for Palestine.

In solidarity and gratitude,

Jill

In 2006, VoteVets spent $100,000 to help elect a candidate running for Congress in Minnesota few people thought would win. His name was Tim Walz.
#
$5.
That is the donation we are asking you to make before Tim Walz takes the stage to address the nation as the Democratic nominee for Vice President of the United States.
$5 because way back in 2006, we spent $100,000 to elect Tim Walz in a race few thought he would win. We were one of the only outside spending organizations involved, and he won by just 15,000 votes.
$5 because from the beginning, VoteVets has done more than any organization to elect a bench of progressive veterans, and tonight we see just how important that work is.
$5 because we can reach the independent and moderate voters in swing states no one else can and we will put every dollar we raise into making sure we win this November.
Tim Walz' selection is a testament to the work we've done over the years, and none of it would have been possible without the support from people like you.
And anything we accomplish this November is only because of your support as well, so please donate today:

Yesterday, we made waves at the DNC with our powerful "Fire Jim Jordan" action right outside the United Center.

We’re sending a clear message: We’re here to take down the most dangerous man in Congress, and we’re not stopping until the job is done.
The reason Jim Jordan won’t be Speaker of the House, the reason he won’t be in Congress much longer, and the reason he won’t be able to hide from his record as an abuse enabler is because of the hard-working team that rallied together at our event.

If you’re ready to see an end to Jim Jordan’s toxic reign and want to be part of the movement making history, now is the time to step up. | | I just stepped off the DNC stage, and I wanted to share with you the message I shared at the DNC: When I was a kid, my parents brought me to the Capitol and taught me that it's sacred ground, a symbol of our democracy. When I got to Congress, I was excited to bring my little boys to the same beautiful building. I asked them, "Do you like the Capitol?" My oldest, Austin, said, "I love the Capitol. And lower case, too." But shortly after, we saw something unimaginable – a mob tearing down flags and assaulting police officers. That night, I walked into the rotunda. The floor was covered in broken glass and garbage. Strewn with the chaos unleashed by Donald Trump. I thought, "How did it get this bad?" So I did the only thing I could think of: I grabbed a trash bag and started cleaning up. What I learned on January 6th is that all of us are caretakers of our great republic. We can heal this country, but only if we try. Always remember, this chaos that we see doesn't have to be this way. I refuse to believe our kids are doomed to grow up in a broken America. There is a hunger for a new generation of leadership, a new era of public service. This election, we have a choice. A choice between hope or fear, and a choice between a forward-looking campaign and one that would drag our country backward. I know which one I'm choosing to support. Big polling news out of Ohio! **Bernie Moreno** has pulled to within **_4 points_** of liberal Senator **Sherrod Brown** in what may be the closest Senate race of 2024. There are two huge data points in this poll, which shows Brown with 46% and Moreno with 42%. _First_ , it shows Moreno has cut Brown’s lead _in half_ since May. _Second_ , this is the first poll of the cycle with Brown _under 50%_! This is a HUGE problem for incumbent candidates who are universally known in their states. It’s a signal that Ohio voters _do not support_ Sherrod Brown and are looking for new leadership. This would be a major story even if this race were a fair fight. But it’s not. As a lifelong politician and chairman of the Senate Banking Committee, Sherrod Brown’s campaign is cashing checks from special interests left and right. He has spent _**FOUR TIMES AS MUCH**_ as Moreno. Yet despite a hurricane of false attacks from Sherrod Brown and the press, Moreno has closed the Ohio Senate race to a statistical dead heat. _Why?_ **Because his message is finally breaking through.**
---
---
Ohio is a red state, and Sherrod Brown is as blue as any Democrat in Washington. Unlike Brown, Moreno actually represents the people and the values of the Buckeye State. **Bernie Moreno is a principled conservative who will fight for border security, a strong economy, school choice, American energy, a strong military, medical freedom, and election integrity!!** But this means he will face the worst from the radical Left. name: Joseph, A TN Kid for Kamala
subject: Wait a Minute—You Didn’t See the Best Part!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by TN Voter Project; Danielle Inez, Treasurer
body:
https://www.tennesseevoterproject.com [https://www.tennesseevoterproject.com]
Hey everyone,
It’s Joseph. I’m 9 years old, and I just got back from Day Two of the Democratic National Convention. It was pretty awesome. I’ve been learning a lot about the Midwest, how our government works, and why this election really matters.
Last night, I got to be on the convention floor with the Tennessee Delegation, and I even snapped a few pictures. One of my favorites has President Obama in it. My mom’s a big fan of Michelle Obama, and seeing her light up when Michelle spoke was a moment I won’t forget.
Here’s the thing: this election isn’t just another one. It’s about making sure people like my mom, Grandma, and little sister have the rights they deserve. I’m all in for Kamala Harris because having the first Black woman president would be a game-changer.
Michelle Obama told us to “Do something.” So, I’m on a mission. I’m raising $3,000 to help the Tennessee Voter Project turn Tennessee blue and get Kamala Harris elected. Every dollar we get helps us register new voters, educate people, and make sure they show up when it counts.
If you want to be part of something that matters, now’s the time. Clink the link to make a donation if you’re in, and let’s make this happen. I even included my exclusive photo of President Obama if you click the link.
Thanks for the support.
My name’s Joseph—and I approve this message.

name: Wes Moore
subject: I just finished my remarks at the Democratic National Convention
body:
Friend, I just finished my remarks on the Democratic National Convention stage — take a look:

It was an honor to address the party and the country to support Kamala Harris as our next President Before I tell you more, please help us secure Kamala’s win this November by making a split contribution between her campaign and mine. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20240821-1?refcode=em20240821-1]

I joined the Army when I was seventeen – and led soldiers in combat in Afghanistan.

My training taught me you never learn anything about anybody when times are easy — you learn about them when times are hard.

Kamala Harris is the right one to lead us in this moment.

The future of our country is in the hands of all of us, right now . The choices that we make today will determine what the future looks like for our children, so we have the responsibility to select the best leadership to move us forward.

The best choice is Kamala Harris. Kamala has the experience, the fight, and the vision. She is a leader who brings people in rather than pushing them out. She is a leader who knows just what service means, and the importance of serving the country.

We are a nation of patriots who serve when the mission is hard and the destination is uncertain. And I know our history isn’t perfect. The unevenness of the American journey has made some skeptical. I’m not asking you to give up your skepticism. I just want that skepticism to be your companion, and not your captor – and I'm asking that you join us in the work!

In Maryland, we’re doing something special right now – we're choosing to work together. We are focused on bringing people in rather than pushing them out, because together, we win.

Tonight, my message was clear: the only way to make our country better is to work together. So let’s roll up our sleeves to elect Kamala Harris, and ensure we have a strong partner in Washington, D.C. for the next four years. Split a contribution right now so we can hit the ground running to help Kamala win in November. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20240821-1?refcode=em20240821-1]

Elevate,

Wes

“Kamala is brat.”
“You think you just fell out of a coconut tree?”
“This is the ‘vibes’ election.”
Have you heard or seen any of these comments lately? On the internet, from your Gen Z relatives, or even on CNN?
I have – and while I’ll admit I don’t always know what everything means right away (Millennial alert!), here’s something I can say with 100% confidence:
We are seeing unprecedented excitement and momentum for Kamala Harris and Tim Walz — from people of all ages and all backgrounds — and I am ALL IN!
This week, I’m in Chicago as a delegate to the Democratic National Convention, and while I’ve already cast my official nominating ballot for Kamala Harris, I am so excited to be a part of this historic moment in our party and hear from Kamala about what we can accomplish in the years ahead *and* what we need to do over the next three months to get there.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
I am so pumped to work with Kamala Harris’s campaign to make sure we win the White House — and here’s an incredibly exciting part of that:
Thanks to the momentum we’re seeing from Democrats this summer, we have an even better shot at turning out enough voters to flip the House blue.
With a Democratic majority in the House, we’ll finally be able to operate in a functioning government and deliver results and solutions for families across California and the country.
But we won’t win this election on vibes alone (no matter how immaculate), so we need to put in the hard work. I’m ready to do my part, and I’m asking you to join me:
Will you chip in to help me defeat my extreme opponent, hold onto my seat, and flip the House? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]

subject: ⚡ You can feel the energy / Puedes sentir la energía ⚡
body:
Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español]
Endorsing a leader and ready to make history
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Kamala%20tan%20suit%20DNC.jpg]
Last Thursday, TOP proudly announced our endorsement of Vice President Kamala Harris for U.S. President. As an organization committed to championing Black and Latino communities across Texas, this endorsement marks a pivotal moment in our mission to ensure that communities of color not only have a seat at the table but also the power to drive meaningful change in our state.
For over 240 years, the United States has struggled to fulfill its promise of a democracy that serves all its people. In all that time, we’ve only elected one Black president and one Black woman vice president. The threat to democracy posed by Trump and his MAGA agenda movement, fueled by white supremacy, is undeniable and as dangerous as ever. Kamala Harris is a qualified, proven leader committed to our values who will protect and continue the progress we’ve fought so hard to achieve.
This endorsement is grounded in ensuring that our communities — Black, Latino, and working-class Texans — have a voice and means to shape a democracy that looks like us and reflects our values. TOP’s members know what’s at stake: a government that works for the powerful few, or a future where we all have the opportunity to thrive. Kamala Harris has stood with our communities, and we’re ready to stand with her to fight for a state and country where justice and equity can be fully realized for every person – regardless of race, age, gender, or income.
During the 2022 election cycle, TOP reached over 1.4 million Black voters, and this cycle, we’re doubling down to turn out Black and Latino Texans across the state. Our work is far from done, and this endorsement is just the beginning.
SHARE TOP’s endorsement graphic of Kamala on your Facebook here. [https://www.facebook.com/OrganizeTexas/posts/pfbid0LvREyWweEMsTQCgdpkgG2ukkaWNpGqgMb34SqQuQHdbH1z6QB8fVfjXv9DPLeEQLl?rdid=UTLIFajJaV6go1Kj]
Joining allies for a fun-filled night as we fight for change in San Antonio
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/ACT4SA.jpg]
SAN ANTONIO! Join TOP from 6 - 9 this Friday for a fun night at The Brick @ Blue Star, as we celebrate the 3rd birthday of our friends in the movement at ACT 4 SA. Learn more about their community-driven work here. [https://act4sa.org/]
Come drop by for good food, drinks, and company, as well as a silent auction for local tickets and artwork. DJ Stevie and Ed Saveedra will be spinning tunes!
PURCHASE your event tickets for this Friday. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/3rdbday]
ADD YOUR NAME: Pushing for Medicare for All and the quality healthcare our communities deserve
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Medicare%20for%20all%20english%20spanish.jpg]
EVERYONE -- regardless of race, age, gender, or economic status -- deserves quality, affordable, and accessible healthcare. It's why TOP unapologetically acknowledges that healthcare is a human right.
Medicare, the ACA, and CARE ACT are what our Texas communities need!
We're proud to be in solidarity with our national partners at Center for Popular Democracy to #ProtectTheACA, fight for #MedicareForAll, and put #PeopleOverProfit.
USE THIS ONLINE TOOL to tell your members of Congress to protect and expand the ACA and join us in the fight for healthcare as a human right by co-sponsoring the Medicare for All Act. [https://secure.everyaction.com/YFvxYXEz00uP_tdAwwoozw2]
TOP Tips: Adjust settings to keep your phone from overheating
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Phone%20overheating.jpg]
It's HOT out there. We know. Those handheld technological devices we rely on each and every day aren't built to withstand these scorching temperatures. Change settings on your smartphone to keep it from overheating and protect it from damage. [https://www.cnet.com/pictures/hot-weather-cool-phone-expert-tips-to-avoid-phone-overheating/]
Español
Respaldando a un líder y listo para hacer historia
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Kamala%20tan%20suit%20DNC.jpg]
El jueves pasado, TOP anunció con orgullo nuestro respaldo a la Vicepresidenta Kamala Harris para la Presidencia de los Estados Unidos. Como organización comprometida con defender a las comunidades Negras y Latinas en todo Texas, este respaldo marca un momento crucial en nuestra misión de garantizar que las comunidades de color no solo tengan un asiento en la mesa, sino también el poder de impulsar un cambio significativo en nuestro estado.
Durante más de 240 años, Estados Unidos ha luchado por cumplir su promesa de una democracia que sirva a todo su pueblo. En todo ese tiempo, sólo hemos elegido un presidente Negro y una Vicepresidenta Negra. La amenaza a la democracia que plantea Trump y su movimiento de agenda MAGA, impulsado por la supremacía blanca, es innegable y más peligrosa que nunca. Kamala Harris es una líder calificada, comprobada y comprometida con nuestros valores que protegerá y continuará el progreso por el que hemos luchado tan duro.
Este respaldo se basa en garantizar que nuestras comunidades (negras, latinas y texanas de clase trabajadora) tengan voz y medios para dar forma a una democracia que se parezca a nosotros y refleje nuestros valores. Los miembros de TOP saben lo que está en juego: un gobierno que trabaje para unos pocos poderosos o un futuro en el que todos tengamos la oportunidad de prosperar. Kamala Harris ha apoyado a nuestras comunidades y estamos listos para apoyarla en la lucha por un estado y un país donde la justicia y la equidad puedan realizarse plenamente para todas las personas, independientemente de su raza, edad, género o ingresos.
Durante el ciclo electoral de 2022, TOP llegó a más de 1.4 millones de votantes negros y, en este ciclo, estamos redoblando nuestro esfuerzo para atraer a texanos negros y latinos en todo el estado. Nuestro trabajo está lejos de terminar y este respaldo es solo el comienzo.
COMPARTE el gráfico de respaldo de TOP a Kamala en tu Facebook aquí. [https://www.facebook.com/OrganizeTexas/posts/pfbid0LvREyWweEMsTQCgdpkgG2ukkaWNpGqgMb34SqQuQHdbH1z6QB8fVfjXv9DPLeEQLl?rdid=yapZxCPqegKQo8RL]
Unimos a aliados para una noche llena de diversión mientras luchamos por el cambio en San Antonio
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/ACT4SA.jpg]
¡SAN ANTONIO! Únase a TOP de 6pm a 9pm este Viernes para una noche divertida en The Brick @ Blue Star, mientras celebramos el tercer cumpleaños de nuestros amigos del movimiento en ACT 4 SA. Obtenga más información sobre su trabajo impulsado por la comunidad aquí. [https://act4sa.org/]
Visítenos para disfrutar de buena comida, bebidas y compañía, así como de una subasta silenciosa de entradas y obras de arte locales. ¡DJ Stevie y Ed Saveedra tocarán canciones!
COMPRA tus entradas para el evento de este viernes. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/3rdbday]
AGREGUE SU NOMBRE: Abogando por Medicare para Todos y la atención médica de calidad que nuestras comunidades merecen
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Medicare%20for%20all%20english%20spanish.jpg]
TODOS, independientemente de su raza, edad, género o situación económica, merecen atención médica de calidad, asequible y accesible. Es por eso que TOP reconoce sin temor alguno que la atención médica es un derecho humano.
¡Medicare, ACA y CARE ACT son lo que nuestras comunidades de Texas necesitan!
Estamos orgullosos de solidarizarnos con nuestros socios nacionales del Centro para la Democracia Popular para #ProtectTheACA, luchar por #MedicareForAll y poner #PeopleOverProfit.
UTILICE ESTA HERRAMIENTA EN LÍNEA para decirles a sus miembros del Congreso que protejan y amplíen la ACA y se unan a nosotros en la lucha por la atención médica como un derecho humano copatrocinando la Ley Medicare para Todos. [https://secure.everyaction.com/YFvxYXEz00uP_tdAwwoozw2]
Consejos de TOP: Ajuste la configuración para evitar que su teléfono se sobrecaliente
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Phone%20overheating.jpg]
Hace CALOR afuera. Sabemos. Esos dispositivos tecnológicos portátiles en los que confiamos todos los días no están diseñados para soportar estas temperaturas abrasadoras. Cambie la configuración de su teléfono inteligente para evitar que se sobrecaliente y protegerlo de daños. [https://www.cnet.com/pictures/hot-weather-cool-phone-expert-tips-to-avoid-phone-overheating/]

name: Tim Walz
subject: I haven’t given a lot of big speeches like this one in my life, but I’ve given a lot of pep talks.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Harris for President
body:
Peter, I just got off the stage at the Democratic National Convention. | | |
---
Peter, I just got off the stage at the Democratic National Convention. I haven’t given a lot of big speeches like this one in my life, but I’ve given a lot of pep talks. So let me say this: It’s the fourth quarter. We’re down a field goal, but we’re on offense. We’re driving down the field. _And, boy, do we have the right team to win this._ **Kamala Harris is tough. She’s experienced. And she’s ready. Our job is to get in the trenches and do the blocking and tackling. One inch at a time, one yard at a time, one $25 donation at a time.** [You’re one of our most engaged grassroots supporters. Will you make a $25 donation tonight? name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: free abortions at the DNC in Chicago
disclaimer_text: paid for by taxpayers
body:
At the DNC, the most insane thing happened!
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

The Democratic National Convention just kicked off on Monday, and we’ve already heard some of the most radical and extreme abortion rhetoric ever uttered on American soil.

But even worse than their comments trying to paint **killing preborn babies** as “reproductive healthcare” is what _Planned Parenthood_ is actually **_DOING_** right outside the United Center in Chicago, Illinois.

[](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gtdduhl-duchtdja-y/)
Pro-Life Friend, they say _actions speak louder than words._

And no action could be more telling of how extreme Democrats have become than having a mobile abortion mill butchering babies outside of their Convention . . .

I knew the DNC was going to be bad, but this has to be one of the vilest things I’ve ever seen!

And moreover, they’re spewing their radical abortion-on-demand agenda on-stage at the DNC – _and on national television!_

**Pro-life Americans MUST fight back against this insanity!**

**[So, would you please make your most generous contribution to help _Students for Life Action_ keep our brand-new attack ad on the air](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gtdduhl-duchtdja-j/)?**

If you haven‘t seen our ad, you can view it **[here](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gtdduhl-duchtdja-t/)!**

[](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gtdduhl-duchtdja-i/)
Your generosity will allow me to expose DNC delegates AND roll out this ad in key, targeted Battleground States.

The fact is, voters need to know the TRUTH about Kamala Harris’ radical record on abortion, which includes:

**> >> _Voting AGAINST the Born-Alive Abortion Survivors Act as a U.S. Senator_.** This bill would simply require that babies who are born alive after a botched abortion receive proper medical care. But Kamala Harris would rather these babies simply be left to die screaming on cold hospital tables before their little bodies are taken out with the trash;

**> >> _Becoming the first Vice President in American history to visit an abortion facility_.** As she spoke to the press inside a building where innocent little boys and girls are slaughtered, Vice President Harris had the audacity to blast pro-life laws for being “immoral” – as if protecting innocent life is evil;

**> >> _Rushing to the defense of _Planned Parenthood__** after the _Center for Medical Progress_ caught them red-handed on undercover video chopping up recently aborted babies and selling their organs for spare parts. As Attorney General of California, she went after the man who recorded these videos, David Daleiden, instead of the monsters engaged in this horrific practice;

**> >> _Praising efforts to shut down Pregnancy Resource Centers_** to coerce vulnerable mothers into abortion violence instead of receiving life-affirming aid and ensure _Planned Parenthood_ can commit as many abortions as possible and keep funneling profits into the campaigns of radical pro-abortion politicians; and

**> >> _Refusing to name a single abortion limit she’d support_** and backing Biden-Harris Administration efforts to impose late-term abortion on all 50 states in the country – _all paid for by taxpayers._
[](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gtdduhl-duchtdja-d/) In fact, Kamala has radicalized Democrats to such an extent that a pro-abortion mob paraded through the streets of Chicago during the DNC the other day wearing Chemical Abortion Pill costumes!

They’ve gone from lying about the reality of abortion to boldly screaming that they want to end the lives of precious little preborn boys and girls in a matter of weeks.

**__They just can’t contain their bloodlust anymore_._**

**[That’s why I’m counting on your support for _Students for Life Action_ today – to help me spread the TRUTH about just how radical Kamala Harris is on abortion](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gtdduhl-duchtdja-h/).**

If we don’t, who will?

It’s time to act before the America you and I love is gone forever.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

P.S. – They say, _actions speak louder than words._

And no action could be more telling of how extreme Democrats have become than having a mobile abortion mill butchering babies outside of their Convention . . .

I knew the DNC was going to be bad, but this has to be one of the vilest things I’ve ever seen!

And moreover, they’re spewing their radical abortion-on-demand agenda on-stage at the DNC – _and on national television!_

**Pro-life Americans MUST fight back against this insanity!**

**[So, would you please make your most generous contribution to help _Students for Life Action_ keep our brand-new attack ad on the air](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gtdduhl-duchtdja-k/)?**

If you haven't seen our ad, you can view it **[here](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gtdduhl-duchtdja-u/)!**

. . . Because I know that your inbox is probably crowded with so many political emails, emails about the state of our country and the numerous important elections that are happening right now.

And more importantly, I know that you are busy with a life of your own, a family of your own, and daily trials and joys of your own.

So, I hope you know that taking a minute out of your day to read about my critical battle to defeat Democrat Adam Schiff and fight for the future of California means the world to me.

**[Can I count on you to stick with me through November?](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zst920q7bojur4djincjdvh4ror30asdcj8r2g8g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1cph60o76cph2bs)**

If you care about the future of California and the fight to bring commonsense leadership to our country's most left-wing state like I do, the greatest thing you can do is _**[pray for me and my election.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zaatd4vqf5t72i4337dhbskeuf0afuhe0l3kj3vo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1cph60o76cph2bs)**_

So, I'm glad this email reached you, and I hope I can count on your support to defeat Adam Schiff in November.

Thank you for your support.

subject: ray for me and my election

body:
Dear Fellow Patriot,

I just wanted to say _**[thank you](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zvnl55kpfa7nmo90auhnghmrv4c3ju2cnlp49t2g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1cph64or4cjh2bs)**_ - thank you for opening this email.

. . . Because I know that your inbox is probably crowded with so many political emails, emails about the state of our country and the numerous important elections that are happening right now.

And more importantly, I know that you are busy with a life of your own, a family of your own, and daily trials and joys of your own.

So, I hope you know that taking a minute out of your day to read about my critical battle to defeat Democrat Adam Schiff and fight for the future of California means the world to me.

**[Can I count on you to stick with me through November?](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zeterbrsgdl3kp19lminnktlpsh0qcce8utrbr30_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1cph64or4cjh2bs)**

Fellow Patriot, I hope you'll **[join my campaign team today](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zh5hcpflc5uuncvd9ojv12utqg6066ka0homsms0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1cph64or4cjh2bs)** and stay up to date through Election Day. We have less than 3 months to go, and so much is at stake.

If you care about the future of California and the fight to bring commonsense leadership to our country's most left-wing state like I do, the greatest thing you can do is _**[pray for me and my election.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zfbmatr4o3gdoo972jj055achcu82h314vo154dg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1cph64or4cjh2bs)**_

And friend, in addition to your prayers, if you're able, **[a small contribution to my campaign](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zp56f6lqbhuep71t4uadvsapt1rol4iv0gbec388_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1cph64or4cjh2bs)** goes a long way towards helping me fight against Adam Schiff and the Democrat machine backing his campaign.

Because the last thing the Democrats want to see is support from hundreds of individual American patriots donating to my campaign and dreaming of a new Conservative California.

So, I'm glad this email reached you, and I hope I can count on your support to defeat Adam Schiff in November.

Thank you for your support.

Let's win this together,
[](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zqmnf77amhl4igbef5kmf46s49malsrf0t62to6o_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1cph64or4cjh2bs)
Steve Garvey

## Ukraine Unleashes Major Strike on Russia
The Ukrainian military [targeted Moscow](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDFvwyAUhH8N3ojgGcdkYOjClq4dLQSPhAbzLCC28u-rdOrQ7aQ7nT59X9fl6lJO5fbpVjQ90uJ8TzsumgNwUIsagomIgOOARs6gxlFNsxzuxmtACBcVz1LAOc5jHKP0E2o3aT0FNyQDApTQAFKIWajTJGDWFym0mBTKSTMlMKRO9fRNqfQ7xvyiHevJ0zpkc-99a2z8YGAZ2PLaqPV3xcC-jxlYod9ZMrAH1Rx4waMxsM9Hdakgd707_2h8pebp4KlwKsgp8uzqDVvnuGPlodKfLRVen60lV7h3W-ouM7BDNWE7Us6pnWemxG11Kf9S9v-d7QZ-AgAA___cZW4R) with at least 11 drones on Wednesday in one of the largest attacks on the Russian capital since the war began.Ukraine reportedly [deployed drones](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsjzFuwzAMAF9jbw4oioqkQUOXbOna0WAlOmGr2IGtOOjvi3TueLjhcB_n8cxadb68801Sm5aRc9NdxjAgDkgj9SVNIii2l2Q8krXkvOmvSegYqUTITL5A5uLIForggkRrJu41ISBBQDQAHujgAH2IBgI4EuNCRyBF27Ievhad21Wm-rPssh7ycutrurZ23zr71uGpwxPfZ3luL_WCtWmu0uFpfWyb8vD4XllnGQJG4QwlQHAGXZjAllBi_uTJGxHu11TuT61Vt6PvCC431vrXa__f7wl_AwAA__93PFnY) to at least five Russian regions as ground forces continued to advance in Russia's Kursk region. In the past week, Ukraine also has struck three bridges, several airfields, and an oil depot.Russian officials [claim 45 Ukrainian drones](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7GO6yAQRb8Gd1gwBpsUFK9xl9duaU3MOJkNNhGQsPv3q2y93ZWudI7Ox3k5I0c-rv9xJ1-3tOBa-UWLkwASzGK64DcioKEjrycww2DspLubt5d1tWhR44h2DBqCvWzWXsgRnKZh7NiDAqMcgFZqUqa3CiZ30sopa0hbJ4yiwDXl_jPxUW-0xe_0otyvae-iv9X6KGL4J2AWMLfWevziVN6vgPnNFjAr995awPy8Z-SD5J7KmpoMOR0ksVZc7zI_S2GUDXOXfXg0jpHLOAmjrjty_BXWv_NfHn4CAAD___2FWxQ) were shot down during the attack, including 11 in Moscow, 23 over the Bryansk Region, six over the Belgorod region, three over the Kaluga region, and two over the Kursk region, areas relatively near Moscow.Meanwhile, Ukrainian forces [shot down at least 50 Russian](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGO4yAQgOGnwZ2tYcCGFBQnnSxdkWu3tAgex7PBEAFJlLdf7dZb_82v7-O8nD1HTtf__iDXtrz40PhJi-0Re9SL7la3ESGpjpw0qJXSo5Hd7k6glFWaJgVmGkcJyl705MOI8kKrtR07BNRgESWAAT2MgMaeJFgYNcnRCg20cstl-Myc2k5bfOcnlSHko4tub-1ehfojcBY4-0tI9KrDNX9ngfO_1Kgk3zgnHwXOj1vxnKiP_pHCTrVfS07U-9Z8uPVHriG_-rxtHNjHKnCuLZe3UDOvQv2VUgFoY1VX3Hp_cYxcJyM0XA_P8eeo_e7zdPgVAAD__1h1ZlU) drones and subdued 16 others in a prolonged attack that started on Tuesday and ended on Wednesday, according to officials.
## Heat Dome Scorches Southwest
A heat dome is [blanketing the Southwest and Texas](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFu9CAQhJ8Gd7aWBf_gguJv6C5tSgvh9ZkIm5PZO3JvHzl1qplipPn0fd7mW0g5HfePsJPjtcwhcnrRbHvEHvWsu8WtREiqIycNaqX0aGS3uXFCHSGGNS5SSiNB2RDsNMXFrCZK1SWHgBosogQwoIcR0NhJgoVRkxyt0EBL4nIOXyUdvNGa3-VF5xDL3mW3MT-qUP8FeoG-tTY8a-CyhPc1EOgrl_Mt0B_U6hWBUzkE-utWoAd7dSnQ0zeftFO_UeC-lidvjSr392de-1hCZYHeaGsBpQIwAn13uuXRUs6p_jNCw30PKf9y8d-WXg5_AgAA__9aZmX9), putting over 23 million Americans under heat advisories or warnings.Parts of Arizona, New Mexico, and Texas are forecast to experience near-record temperatures, with Phoenix reaching 112 degrees Fahrenheit on Tuesday.The heat wave is straining Texas' electric grid, which hit a preliminary record demand of 85,558.98 megawatts.The extreme heat is expected to persist through the end of the week, [with heat alerts issued](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L9uwyAQgPGnwRvWceBABoZKFVu6VFVH62zOMS0xEUb58_ZVO3f-hk_6fZ7GE6WctvMbXdi3pYw0t3Tj0UlEiWY0XfQLM7Lu2CuLRmszWNWtHmjSdlIcieJhQT4CGTpONAG4aIm65BHQgENUABZMPwBad1TgYDCsBicMcEyt1P6rpK2tvORnuXHt53Lpsl9bu-5CvwgMAgNN88b3vT-X3ywwfLwLDI0ftEt-XLkm3maWd-ZvWXkuNcqVqQkMeyv1KXRIUehXpTQoa4ZDV3283lPOaT9YYeB8oZT_zu1_h5vHnwAAAP__H0Veaw) for Florida, Texas, Oklahoma, and New Mexico, where heat indexes could reach up to 116 degrees.
## List: The Oldest Restaurant in Each State
A list of the oldest restaurants in every state includes several historic taverns, saloons, and inns, including several that predate the United States. [You can see a map here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGu4yAQAL8Gd1iwxjYpKK6hy7VXWpxZ2xsRQHjjKH9_utSvnmJG8-e-3AMlyvvv8ETHW1nCynThYiWABLOYLroNEXDo0OkZzDCYcdbd4QyaWRu9rire_oZxmkYdBmuCHaYNI0wdOVBglAXQSs3K9KOC2d60smo0qEcrjMJIXFr_KJT5wC19yoWtX8uzS-5grqcYfgnwAvxFGWugLxTg31WuJTNmFuBfNZUQTwH-v1GAV1qA5wNlSRFPlg1PDq8WMkvKEi9sH3lyYJSUt7K3UA9a5QX9o-5dc7G-KSU6p1kYtT8DpW8S_zzocvAvAAD__xW3Z6I).One of the more interesting and historical eateries is Connecticut's Griswold Inn. British soldiers attacked the restaurant during the War of 1812, demanding breakfast before stealing the bar's rum supply.Perhaps the best-named restaurant on the list is Idaho's Snake Pit. Established in 1880 as a railroad layover spot, the Snake Pit has served as a restaurant for over 100 years and reportedly served as a brothel as well. [You can see the list here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGO6yAQRb8Gd45ggBgKiic9ucu2W1oTM45ZYWPBrFf5-1VSb32lq3PO5226Ycppf3zgRoGXMuHM6aTJ9QA9mMl0MSxEQLqjoAYwWhs7qG4NNmJENTuzaK-89540KGnVfQZE52OXAkgw0gEoKQdpLlbC4LySTlpDyjphJMXEpV6-Stp5pSU_y0n1Mpety2FlPprQ_wSMAsYz7XRgeo8CRqyc5kxNwFhypMZ9pcb4XXHnnk6qz74xMvUbHq8DPUZs671gjWOpM0Wh_7901NVL761UXQ3x-Ek5p3YdhJGPDVN-k_DfXc4AvwEAAP__0F1jnQ).

Friend,

With over 40,000 voters with unverified citizenship in Arizona, we could see non-citizens determine the outcome of federal elections in an important swing state. This is after 6,000 unverified voters were found in voter roles in Virginia. Hopefully the Supreme Court will act to require proof of citizenship, because Kamala Harris and Joe Biden have let millions of illegal immigrants into this country and Democrats are registering them to vote in record numbers. **Arizona is a border state we must help save this state! ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/53401?id=2428485.435.1.bb5e0dce3a5982678f3a74b10c780a94 )**

It's simple, ONE CITIZEN. ONE VOTE.

That's the way it's been and that's what federal law requires. However, even if the Supreme Court doesn't act, this is why I introduced the SAVE ACT - which will protect American voters and prevent non-citizens from voting in federal elections.

-> **The SAVE ACT will:** <-

1. Protect American voters in all states.

2. Prevent the 30+ MILLION illegal aliens from voting and dictating election outcomes.

3. Mandate proof of citizenship to establish eligibility to vote in federal elections.

4. Combat the "Motor Voter" law, which makes it easy for noncitizens (legal & illegal) to vote.

5. Require the Supreme Court to require state officials to verify citizenship.

6. Stop the 10% to 27% of non-citizens who are ILLEGALLY registered to vote in the US.

7. Require states to review existing federal voter registration files and remove all non-citizens.

We need to ensure that our elections are fair, lawful, and free of foreign influence. Congress must pass the SAVE Act.

And though it was blocked by the Senate, the SAVE Act can still be saved in September if Congress attaches it to the next Continuing Resolution spending bill.

The SAVE Act has faced FIERCE OPPOSITION. _ **But I'm NOT giving up.** _

**Rush your help immediately and help me get it across the finish line. ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/53401?id=2428485.436.1.ceff3538463c806e0a647210ccdb02cc )**

## ERCOT Says SA Power Plant Crucial To Grid
The Texas grid operator plans to inspect one of three gas-powered units at CPS Energy's Braunig Power Station near San Antonio to assess [whether it can operate](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kDGP4yAQRn8N7ojwGJu4oEjjbu_KLa0JHhy02CCYjZP8-lPummu2-6T3ik_v82P-wBDDvv7CjSw_fJrRcbjTfJYAEvSsm8Ve1TK2DdnWgO5g7KBrbpbI91qRcwPqcaDWwYALGFyuplcefRMsKNDqDNCqfuj609m1xnS-BzDOoB-FVrQETuXEN2J6YPXxme5UTi5tTbQ35lxFdxEwCZiO4zhtdX8zARPt8rsKmGLwVPkZ6f8tr9-v11sqLrFk_Ar7KitTrpLTgWWRLlWOT5kj7pKT_CLKEte35nKVtFNZ_1GuMmUqyGFfBUxY5OXS5vPvz0dT7JKPEGOogxFarRuG-Pc5_xDybuFPAAAA__9AiHoN) beyond the company's planned suspension on March 31, 2025. CPS Energy informed ERCOT it plans to [shut down the plant](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL_u3CAQhJ8Gd1iw-G9BkYbu0qa01rD2oXBgmdX57u0jp_91I4008-n781geGFPM-298keXPVhb0HN-0TBJAQrd0TbCrCrNuyOoROgOzAdM8rVITTsOsVQ-rXtUwBEQ9-HkLs1HdBE20oKBTE4BW_WD6dvJ6HM3WA4x-xG0WnaIQuZwtP4npg3VL3_Kms_Xl1ST7ZD6qML8EOAHuuq72b0W-SwEu01UFuFQ8JgHuvhLg1HRnLcD5o0rKdO5fSacvLFdkTiTvfelTqTHv0sgdqzzKRScFeSTMXGXMsmKWmLnkWAS45rThuGJKsQ6j6NT-wpj-M_IPyt4W_gUAAP__gEBtQw) due to high operating costs and up to $200 million in needed repairs, which would be passed on to consumers. However, ERCOT argues the plant's 859 megawatts of capacity are essential to [meet state energy demands](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLHOozAQhJ_GdIvM2oApXFxDl2uvRBt7SSwZjGwnJG9_4pqr_mqkmWI-fX9uy41CDPvjN21s62dNC7ka3rwYQATUi268vUs_dQ3bbkStcFKomqc1TL2ZVkM8aaO9UoqURDl2Ew9y6rkJFiVqaRA72Q-qb43rxlGtPeLoRlonoSX7UFNu65Mrf6is8ZvenFuXtibaZ61HEeqXwFngfJ5ny9mleq0C5zVELgJnn9wV15fAWRqBczcInHvo4HV4qgxpB3cU4J3z4wuZY6B7iKF-YXuVCvm1Q94y0O7_FxQr550uF7BlgiMnx6W0h1-bbP1xhhhDGUah5WOjEP8x1x8Uvi3-DQAA___QR3PH), especially given the lack of proposals for new power generation projects. ERCOT will request an inspection of the Braunig Power Station at the Aug. 29 Public Utility Commission meeting, which could take one of the plant's units offline for up to 60 days.
## DNA Links Inmate to 1980 UT Student Murder
Austin police have [made a breakthrough](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGOhCAUAL8GOw08EaWguMZur73SsPJYX4JghJXdv7_s9ddNMckk83NbbpYCxce33dGUl0-LXQtduEwtQAtykY0zd-60aNCIEWQPuoe-2YwDPQmUwgntvbgL9FJp5e7cKqE9Dg0Z4CD5BCD4oPqhm1Yxjr0fAMZ1tF4zydFRSWdXNiz4stmHd7rw7Na0N8FspRyZ9V8MZgZzrbXb39lGG0uKlD4SgzlizQxm-8yF4gfOQmtABnN-ZhvbgPTY2pqCx1ZopSSA7o7taE7jjkohUFYjk_yxWwp_4fLPh8vAbwAAAP__zzdgRQ) in the 1980 murder case of Susan Leigh Wolfe, a 25-year-old nursing student at the University of Texas. DNA evidence from the crime scene matches that of 78-year-old Deck Brewer Jr., who is currently [incarcerated in Massachusetts](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2O3CAURp8Gd3eELww_BUUad5s25egaLjso2F4BHm_ePpr0KT990tHR-fXx-KBSy_75kzYO4zsfD4qjvPjhABFQP_SUwiqTnycOs0Wt0CtU0zMwekdxNSuyy3k1bBQZbw0pPytkP5WAErV0iLO8G3W_uThbq_Id0UZL2QstOZVxtNt48uBv6rn-OV7cbvHYphqeY3x1oX4IXAQu13Xdfr9Ofp8CF2qjxMoCl52vLnCJrWzvudEOqfR49s4dqDXuAzZKDHT2UXaIR00QqTNsZ0vc4MjQz047XEfNbwQaD8bgusrVQnI8gyb2QE5myGycdDqmOcqphfR1lVpLN1Zo-blRqf_kx39avgL-DQAA__-MPHYp) on unrelated charges. Wolfe was kidnapped, sexually assaulted, and murdered on January 9, 1980, the same day she enrolled in UT's nursing school. # Actions Have Consequences (or at least they should)
By Mark Robertson, Candidate for Nevada's First Congressional District
---
Peter,
One of the biggest factors contributing to most of our country's problems is the separation of consequences from people's actions. There is an eternal law that connects specific actions with natural consequences, and this law is being violated on an epic scale. Here are some examples: Student Loans Action: People borrow money and promise to pay it back with interest. Natural Consequence: People are required to pay back the money with interest. Separation of Consequences: The government transfers the debt to people who did not take a loan. Illegal Immigration Action: People break our laws to enter our country illegally. Natural Consequence: The people are turned away at the border or returned to their country. Separation of Consequences: The government provides free food, housing, healthcare, education, cell phones, and other services to these lawbreakers and requires law-abiding citizens to pay the bill. Over Spending by Congress Action: Members of Congress print, borrow, and spend trillions of dollars that we do not have. Natural Consequence: People vote these people out of office. Separation of Consequences: Incumbent members of Congress use government spending to "buy the votes" of their constituents. Shoplifting Action: People shoplift and 'smash and grab' items from hardworking merchants. Natural Consequence: Criminals are caught, prosecuted, imprisoned, and held accountable for restitution. Separation of Consequences: The government allows a person to steal up to $999.00 per theft with no consequence. Gang-organized smash-and-grab' operations are rarely prosecuted. BLM Riots Action: People damage and destroy public and private property by rioting in the streets. Natural Consequence: Rioters are caught, prosecuted, imprisoned, and held accountable for restitution Separation of Consequences: Most rioters are not prosecuted, and those who are receive light sentences. Unwanted Pregnancy Action: A man and a woman have sexual relations and create a life. Natural Consequence: Parents take responsibility for their children or put them up for adoption. Separation of Consequences: Abortion ends the life of the unborn child, or a deadbeat father justifies not taking responsibility by claiming the mother should have aborted the child. Men Competing in Women's Sports Action: Men cannot successfully compete against other men in athletics. Natural Consequence: Men who are unsuccessful in competing against other men could train harder or pursue other interests. Separation of Consequences: The biological male declares he is now female and takes awards, scholarships, and opportunities away from actual women and girls. Failing Schools Action: Most students cannot perform at grade level in Math, Science, and Reading. Natural Consequence: School District Leaders are fired, and parents are given the option to move their children to higher-performing schools, including public, private, charter, co-opt, homeschooling, etc. Separation of Consequences: School District leaders are given exorbitant salaries and leave with hundreds of thousands in severance pay. Elected officials refuse funding for parents to move their children to better-performing schools. These are just a few examples of liberal policies that separate consequences from actions. As Americans, we are free to choose our actions, but we are not free to choose the consequences of those actions. To preserve our Nation, we must return to conservative principles that hold people accountable for their actions. We should follow God's example of justice and mercy.
*******
---
Your Questions--Mark's Answers
Mark Robertson answers your questions with direct and honest answers. Here are two questions Mark was asked recently:
Q: [What do you perceive to be the United States' greatest challenges as a nation over the next decade? ](https://dwhdqsbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001nymhBLV1rpf0aMFKyj3p6hDgTI2WWXVzP7tKKxNnSNig9iaMEp7X543bQb24ePws1Un6RtAvrCJVCb98whafL28YzpK8aiV1nk3ajakWKfConVq-9LYpkKkrcf2VnLAosEPp6_I3eRiS67SIF7yUlKBsLJ8jdKnxU8lbt5ruSC29RIfABDpreWRFuCZDaN7498vPOFsgaocyJ7seSVle8_P_WIhRy5jj&c=PsvmKjNd6jbnBhqkTXpHuzBRd6MjaGYEXHp4qrBnUL4PmoeYTUlzbQ==&ch=_3s6C62xbyz5STR2s2vaRy7hxCsFaFkAr16nyLwwQdaHwtQIqXNMPQ==) A: The national debt. Unrestrained illegal immigration. Woke philosophy in education and our national institutions. Breakdown of the rule of law.
Q: [Do you believe that compromise is necessary or desirable for policymaking? ](https://dwhdqsbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001nymhBLV1rpf0aMFKyj3p6hDgTI2WWXVzP7tKKxNnSNig9iaMEp7X543bQb24ePwsmulbTDMZpEpUDIH3NU0AChKBhx709DQZQfGqx6ReJr9-nZzj9g50RoMM6_EDzMbdVQKLez3Y3HfJRl8SNPcF_L5RqYTklTalRI1nLRDBT-IZHr3y1kYp7ga77wqqkxLlkVUniRXBlCBzk5940gz_fD9Wnt9BGbcyP2x7uv-00N4=&c=PsvmKjNd6jbnBhqkTXpHuzBRd6MjaGYEXHp4qrBnUL4PmoeYTUlzbQ==&ch=_3s6C62xbyz5STR2s2vaRy7hxCsFaFkAr16nyLwwQdaHwtQIqXNMPQ==) A: Our country was founded on compromise. It is necessary in a democratic republic. However, we should never compromise on integrity, honesty, and ethics.

Letter Closing at Midnight! >>
| **FOLKS, WE’RE _ABSOLUTELY THRILLED!!_** [ ](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/75689?t=6&akid=16309%2E878179%2ERbnOUi) This is a HISTORIC moment!

We want to celebrate Kamala’s VP pick with an outpouring of support – _and it starts with 10,000 Democrats signing our card to Tim Walz!_

[**We know this card will go VIRAL – so don’t miss your chance to sign! Add your name to Tim Walz’s card right now and CONGRATULATE our potential next VP! »**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/75689?t=7&akid=16309%2E878179%2ERbnOUi) | [**Donate $3 to sign the letter now »**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/75689?t=8&akid=16309%2E878179%2ERbnOUi)
---
TO: Governor Tim Walz
FROM: A hopeful Democrat
Subject: CONGRATULATIONS Dear Gov. Walz – _CONGRATULATIONS!_

**We cannot begin to tell you the sense of relief we had when we found out you will be Harris’ running mate this November!**

Your progressive agenda and record will be _essential_ for Democrats to hold onto the White House this November.

**We know fighting against MAGA extremists like Donald Trump and JD Vance won’t be easy — but you have our full support.**

**So we just wanted to send our congratulations and let you know we’re on team Harris-Walz!**

[**I hope you know that there are MILLIONS of us across the country that stand with you. That’s why I’m signing this card and chipping in $3 to Voter Protection Project to show our support and gratitude and to continue to elect incredible Democrats like you »**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/75689?t=9&akid=16309%2E878179%2ERbnOUi) [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/75689?t=10&akid=16309%2E878179%2ERbnOUi) | [**Donate $3 to sign now »**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/75689?t=11&akid=16309%2E878179%2ERbnOUi)

Peter, down-ballot races are built different. While campaigns toward the top of the ticket rake in big money, state campaigns are often run on lean budgets. Take a look at these stats from the 2020 elections in Arizona:
* U.S. Senate: The Democratic and Republican nominees raised a combined total of over _$170 million_.
* State legislature: Nearly 200 candidates for the State House and Senate, all put together, raised about 5% of that — around $9.6 million in total. On average, each Democrat raised $48,450, and each Republican brought in $51,490.

Now Arizona is one of our priority states for the 2024 elections. Democrats only need to flip two seats each in the House and Senate to gain control of both chambers, which would pave the way toward strengthening the state’s redistricting process. **As we work across the country to elect Democracy Defenders to critical positions in state government, a little goes a long way. clean_body: A little goes a long way. | Peter, down-ballot races are built different. While campaigns toward the top of the ticket rake in big money, state campaigns are often run on lean budgets. Take a look at these stats from the 2020 elections in Arizona: U.S. Senate: The Democratic and Republican nominees raised a combined total of over $170 million. State legislature: Nearly 200 candidates for the State House and Senate, all put together, raised about 5% of that — around $9.6 million in total. On average, each Democrat raised $48,450, and each Republican brought in $51,490. Now Arizona is one of our priority states for the 2024 elections. Democrats only need to flip two seats each in the House and Senate to gain control of both chambers, which would pave the way toward strengthening the state’s redistricting process. As we work across the country to elect Democracy Defenders to critical positions in state government, a little goes a long way. body:

---
|

| **RPVI Website**
The Republican Party in the Virgin Islands is excited to announce the launch of our new digital home at [RPVI.org](https://republicanpartyinthevirginislands.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9aec4429d4907d8f643606ded&id=012a87702b&e=4f81ceec6f)! This website is your go-to source for everything related to the RPVI. Whether you want to join our cause, understand our policy stances, or familiarize yourself with our candidates, this site has you covered.
On the website, visitors can quickly become members, donate, and stay updated on upcoming events. The website makes it simple for voters to access crucial information about the party, ensuring everyone stays informed as we work together toward a brighter future for the Virgin Islands.
Your feedback is important to us, so check it out and let us know what you think!
---
[Check it out](https://republicanpartyinthevirginislands.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9aec4429d4907d8f643606ded&id=a57fa59e16&e=4f81ceec6f)
|
---
| **RPVI St. Croix Office Grand Opening**
With the support of Valerie Stiles and a generous donation from the Pickard family, the RPVI proudly celebrated the successful grand opening of our new St. Croix office!
This new space is a crucial hub for our campaign operations, providing a place for voters to connect with our candidates, share their concerns, and get involved in the political process. We're excited to have this office as our central base on St. Croix, helping us build momentum and strengthen our presence as we head toward the general election.
---
|
---
| **RPVI Ad Campaign**
---
| The RPVI has begun launching ad campaigns to highlight our candidates and grow the party’s base. These campaigns are strategically designed to resonate with Virgin Islanders by focusing on the values that matter most to our community: economic opportunity, energy stability, and a brighter future for all.
Between now and the general election, the RPVI will be laser-focused on bringing new voters into our party and drawing support for our candidates. We are leveraging every tool at our disposal to reach out to Virgin Islanders through multiple channels. Our social media campaigns are tailored to engage voters where they are most active, encouraging conversations and building connections with a broad and diverse audience.
In addition to our digital efforts, we are making a significant push through radio ads that speak directly to the concerns and hopes of the people. Utilizing popular VI-based media outlets to ensure our message is heard loud and clear across the islands. These combined efforts are designed to not only boost awareness of our candidates but to also strengthen our party's presence in the community.
The RPVI is committed to expanding our reach and building a strong, united base of support. As we move closer to the election, our focus will remain on connecting with voters, understanding their needs, and demonstrating how our candidates are the best choice to lead the Virgin Islands toward a prosperous future.
---
| **Candidate Donation Match Program**
As part of our support to our endorsed candidates, we are pleased to announce our Donation Match Program. This program will match the first $100 of each individual donation candidates receive.
To participate in this program, candidates are asked to provide receipts for each donation they wish to be matched via email to [admin@rpvi.org](mailto:admin@rpvi.org). This is an excellent opportunity to maximize fundraising efforts and gather the resources needed for a successful campaign!
---
