clean_body: | | | Hi Friend, Welcome to the latest New Pennsylvania Project newsletter! In this edition, you'll find critical election news, upcoming events, and exciting career opportunities. We’re here to keep you informed about our progress to eliminate voting barriers. We will continue to provide key election updates, and highlight the issues that shape Pennsylvania's future. As we gear up for the 2024 general election, we invite you to join us in our mission to mobilize voters to the polls in every election, and to make change in our communities. #WhenWeVoteWeWin | | | | | More than two million Pennsylvanians are eligible to vote, but are not registered or are at severe risk of being dropped off the voting rolls due to inactivity. The last day you can register to vote is on Monday, October 21st, 2024. The voter registration gap is much higher among Black, Indigenous, and other people of color and the youth in Pennsylvania. Voter registration wasn't meant to be inclusive of all people. It was created to restrict voting access. In the case of the youth, only one in four eligible high school students are registered to vote. We are constantly working on improving access and removing barriers to the ballot. With less than two months left to register Pennsylvanians to vote, we are working to continue to register as many voters as possible. We aim to expand democracy by ensuring Pennsylvania’s electorate reflects the Commonwealth’s demographically changing population. Every person in PA has the freedom to make their voices heard; we’re working to ensure that’s the reality. Please check your registration status and speak to those you love about their status. | | | | | Meet Ms. Maria. She is 94 years old. Thanks to the efforts of the New Pennsylvania Project, she will be voting for the first time in her life this year! The generations before us secured our right to vote - let's continue that work, no matter our age. We need to reach out and help our communities be heard this election season! | | | | August 11, 2024 New Pennsylvania Project CEO, Kadida Kenner, appeared on WRNB 100.3 FM with host State Senator Vincent Hughes to talk about all things voting rights and the 2024 election. | | | Above: Gabriela Huerta (right), director of communications at New Pennsylvania Project, registering a voter | | August 13 ,2024 Esperanza hosted the “Your Vote is Your Voice!” event, in collaboration with Univision 65 and Impacto. The New Pennsylvania Project was there to register attendants. Our work was mentioned in both print and online media ( as well as in a live interview on Univision’s newscast . | | | | | August 13, 2024 “By establishing its headquarters in Chester, the New Pennsylvania Project is taking a significant step toward ensuring that every eligible Pennsylvanian has a voice in the democratic process. This move not only benefits the local community, but also contributes to the broader goal of achieving a more inclusive and representative democracy.” - MyChesCo | | Pictured below, New Pennsylvania Project staff celebrating with staff from our affiliated organization, New PA Project Education Fund | | | | | | | | | | Philly Labor Voter Registration Day of Action Saturday, August 24, 2024, 9:00 AMMax Myers Rec Center 1601 Hellerman St, Philadelphia, PA 19149 Join us for a non-partisan event with union members and community members about registering to vote and getting ready to participate in this year's election. | | | New Pennsylvania Project & Climate Power Press Conference Thursday, August 29th, 2:00PM Bell Tower at Temple University Philadelphia, PA 19122 On Thursday, August 29th, at 2 pm, New Pennsylvania Project and Climate Power will host a press conference with elected officials at the Bell Tower of Temple University’s campus to talk about how Pennsylvania is facing increasingly severe weather due to climate change and what elected officials can and should be doing to protect our future. Communities of color disproportionately bear the weight of extreme weather. | | | Opening the Prison Cage: Unerasing Women Behind Bars Thursday, September 19th, 2024 5:30PM-8:30PM Parkway Central Library 1901 Vine St, Philadelphia, PA 19103 The evening will begin with a screening of the film "Kemba," which tells the harrowing yet inspiring story of Kemba Smith's journey from a college student to a federal prisoner, and her eventual pardon. The screening will be followed by a talk-back with Kemba Smith and Kadida Kenner. | | | | | NPP ON THE GROUND Philly Team Continues to Take on Broad St. | | | | | We're loving how many people our Philly team is registering to vote! Go, Philly! | | | RECENT EVENTS | | Block Party Success! | | | | | We had a block party on August 13, 2024 to celebrate the grand opening of our new headquarters in the city of Chester! It was a lovely evening filled with food, games, friendly neighbors, and great conversations. We even managed to register the community to vote during the event! Below is our staff from our recent retreat! The two day retreat was filled with fun, wellness, and learning! As a state-wide organization, we're really grateful for these opportunities to connect and learn from each other. #WhenWeVoteWeWin | | | | | “Pennsylvania is among a few states that require individuals who vote by mail to place their ballots in an inner secrecy envelope before then putting them in an outer envelope. The issue of naked ballots became particularly contentious in the Keystone State ahead of the 2020 election, which spurred litigation that culminated in the Pennsylvania Supreme Court holding that naked ballots are “invalid.”” “If you want to understand what’s happened to voting rights in the U.S. over the past decade, just take a look at the recent ruling by the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit...The holding is legally wrong, yet the Supreme Court could conceivably uphold it, because the decision reflects a long-term conservative strategy: undermining voting rights law one step at a time in relatively low-profile cases rather than through sweeping decisions that draw a public outcry.” “A man faces federal charges that he voted in both Florida and in Pennsylvania for the 2020 presidential election, and twice in Pennsylvania during the November 2022 election.” “A federal judge has ordered Philadelphia to set aside $25 million to ramp up recruitment and retention efforts for the city's Department of Prisons, just over a month after the court found the city in contempt of a settlement in a lawsuit over prison conditions.” | “Both Bush in 2000 and former President Donald Trump in 2016 lost the popular vote, but they won the Electoral College and the presidency... ”We’re going to have to deal with the rules the way they’re structured today, and that means Pennsylvania and Michigan, Arizona, and Nevada are just right at the center of the ballot,” he said.” “Allegheny County Council will soon consider a bill that would require additional steps to ensure only U.S. citizens are registered to vote. The proposed ordinance directs county elections officials to share voter rolls with the Department of Homeland Security prior to the November election, so the department can verify the citizenship of local voters. In the future, the Elections Division would be mandated to confirm every newly registered voter’s citizenship status with DHS.” “The state legislative targets for Democrats closely mirrors that of the presidential race. In North Carolina, the party is hoping to end the Republican supermajorities in both chambers. In Michigan, it’s aiming to hold onto the Democratic trifecta it regained after a special election this spring. The party is looking to make inroads in Pennsylvania (where it narrowly controls the house but not the senate) and take back both chambers in New Hampshire—where it lost out on a majority in the state house by just 11 votes in 2022. Not 11 seats—11 votes.” “A public meeting, billed as a discussion on economic impact, became more like a sermon on the sorority’s VOTE Initiative — Visualize, Organize, Trailblaze, and Empower — and the urgent need to help increase turnout at the polls in November.” “Polls show Vice President Kamala Harris leading former President Donald Trump since becoming the Democratic presidential nominee, a reversal from Trump’s lead over President Joe Biden—as Harris reaches the Democratic National Convention with an edge of three points or more, according to several new surveys.” “The struggle for control of the closely divided Pennsylvania House of Representatives is playing out on thousands of doorsteps across the state, and observers say the final outcome in November will be affected by the presence of Donald Trump and Kamala Harris on the election ballot.” “On his radio show, he emphasized that his support for Harris was not driven by financial incentives but by his personal belief in her ability to lead...Harvey also addressed the importance of the Black vote in the upcoming election, noting its pivotal role in determining the outcome. He referred to the impact of Black voter turnout in key states like Pennsylvania, Georgia, Michigan and Wisconsin, during the last presidential election as evidence of its importance.“The Black vote is not for sale,” Harvey emphasized. “It is a very important bloc of votes that can control the outcome of this election.”” “Native Americans’ low participation in elections stems from a long history of exclusion. Today, it is estimated that roughly one in four eligible Native Americans are not registered to vote... Colorado, Nevada, New Mexico, and Michigan have all passed laws that allow Tribal AVR, with ultimate discretion in the hands of individual Tribal Nations over whether to participate.” “Former President Donald Trump shared a series of AI generated images on Truth Social Sunday night suggesting that superstar Taylor Swift and a group of her followers called "Swifties for Trump" had endorsed him in the 2024 presidential election. The posts were met with outrage on social media, both by Trump's critics Some legal analysts believe Swift has grounds to sue the Republican nominee over the AI-manipulated "false endorsement... Last month, a bi-partisan NO FAKES Act was introduced in the Senate that aims to protect individuals' voices and likenesses from AI-generated replicas.” “Should Kennedy appear on Pennsylvania’s ballot, he could siphon critical support from Republican nominee Donald Trump or Democratic nominee Kamala Harris in a state where a margin of tens of thousands of votes delivered victory to Democrat Joe Biden in 2020 and Trump in 2016. Pennsylvania’s 19 electoral votes — tied with Illinois for fifth most — is of such importance that Harris visited the state Sunday and Trump visited both Saturday and Monday.” “A Commonwealth Court judge agreed with two Democratic Party-aligned challenges on Tuesday, ruling that the paperwork filed by the Party for Socialism and Liberation was fatally flawed and ordering the party’s presidential candidate, Claudia De la Cruz, off Pennsylvania’s Nov. 5 ballot.‘ | | | | | | We're Hiring! # [](https://go.bobcasey.com/go/181?t=1&akid=3948%2E552475%2ENvI3uU)

As I’ve traveled across the Commonwealth, I’ve talked with Pennsylvanians who are struggling with rising costs. That’s why I am leading efforts in the Senate to fight back against corporate greed and hold companies accountable for jacking up prices while they rake in record profits.
From fighting for tax cuts for the middle class, to pushing for anti-price gouging legislation — I’m working on behalf of Pennsylvania families to put money back in your pockets.

That’s why GOP billionaires are spending $75 million to defeat me and elect David McCormick, my hedge fund executive opponent. They know McCormick is committed to corporate tax giveaways that are making these companies even richer.

body:

# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20240822-4227-footer&t=1&akid=4227%2E420207%2Em8zyHk)
What a week it’s been so far, Peter!
On Monday, we heard a rousing speech from President Biden. On Tuesday, Barack and Michele Obama got us fired up and ready to go. And last night, Tim Walz and his entire family touched our hearts.
Now, as we start the final day of the Democratic National Convention, we’re looking forward to hearing Kamala Harris lay out her progressive vision for the future. [**Will you pitch in to help us make that vision a reality?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20240822?refcode=em20240822&amount=3&refcode2=4227_420207_m8zyHk&akid=4227%2E420207%2Em8zyHk)
But this week isn’t just about big keynote speeches. It’s about organizing and continuing to grow our movement — and Pramila has been laser-focused on doing just that. **Yesterday she joined labor leaders to talk about our plan to ensure _everyone_ has the right to organize and join a union:**
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20240822?refcode=em20240822&amount=3&refcode2=4227_420207_m8zyHk&akid=4227%2E420207%2Em8zyHk)
There are even more events today, and Pramila is hard at work to keep our movement in the spotlight. Then once the convention is over, it’s back to Seattle to continue the work at home.
**With just 75 days to go, Tim Walz has it right: we’ll sleep when we’re dead!** Right now we have doors to knock on, phone calls to make, and conversations to have — and we’re going all out, because our democracy itself is on the line.
[**We need your help to meet this moment, Peter. Will you pitch in $3 or anything you can to support our movement and fight back against Donald Trump?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20240822?refcode=em20240822&amount=3&refcode2=4227_420207_m8zyHk&akid=4227%2E420207%2Em8zyHk)

Team Jayapal

As a young organizer and now, member of Congress, I’ve watched Maxwell fight tooth and nail to build a better future for our community and the most vulnerable people in this country. But that hasn’t come without challenges. As a mom, it’s really hard to see your child become a target of racist attacks and far-right conspiracy theorists. But through all these obstacles, Maxwell has built an incredible grassroots movement full of folks who believe in the political power of young people, and I’m overjoyed to see him bring this movement to the national stage. So while Maxwell is onstage rallying voters for Harris-Walz, I’m hoping you can help him keep up his campaign’s youth organizing work off the stage. | As a special education teacher, I’ve seen firsthand how broken our systems are – from underfunded schools to outrageous healthcare costs to juggling different jobs to pay the bills. And I’m so proud that Maxwell and his team are reaching those young people for the Harris-Walz ticket and getting them involved in this election. | | | Donald Trump may have violated the Logan Act, a law that criminalizes the negotiation of a dispute between the US and a foreign government by an unauthorized citizen. [**If he did, he should be prosecuted.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tb245be1f-0c99-4bb5-8d1c-89d2c25fe7ba/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) [Axios](https://default.salsalabs.org/T41916672-6987-48db-92cf-0b2c6c210266/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) reported that Trump spoke on the phone with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, possibly to discuss the ceasefire deal, and Trump may have encouraged him not to take the deal endorsed by President Biden. Both sides are now pushing back, and the details remain murky. Which is why this must be investigated immediately – and if it's true, Trump must be prosecuted for violating the Logan Act. [**Add your name: Investigate Trump, and if warranted, prosecute him and put him in prison >>**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T6df00d99-d669-448d-8aa8-77bcd3bdc23c/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

# 'She Did This'
_Hughes and Former Cassidy Student Celebrate New School and a Renewed Commitment to Education_
* * *
Seven years ago, Sen. Hughes received a letter from a 10-year-old student at the nearly century-old Lewis C. Cassidy Academics School in Overbrook. ** "Every day I go to school I feel like I am in a prison, or a junkyard," Chelsea Mungro wrote. "Why does the color of the students' skin matter how much money we get for our school?"**
* * *
_The new Cassidy school is an 87,729 square foot, three-story building that is designed to accommodate over 600 students from Pre-K through 8th grade._
* * *
Standing in the gymnasium before a ribbon cutting for the sparkling new steel and glass structure that now replaces that crumbling building, Sen. Hughes called Mungro to the stage with him to remind the audience of the power of a single voice. **" She did this," Hughes said. "She DID this."** ****
* * *
Mungo's letter made local and national news, reigniting the debate over Pennsylvania's underfunded and uneven approach to basic education. [In an interview with Sen. Hughes after the ribbon cutting, Mungro described taking national news reporters on a tour of the rodent-infested school.](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100168468.172632.216&gen=1&mailing_linkid=11684) The outcry was followed by successive state budgets that showed continued improvement in the commitment to education, culminating with this year's historic $1.1 billion funding increase. Sen. Hughes and Mungro joined local officials, community leaders, students, and parents recently for the celebration at the new 87,729 square foot, three-story building that is designed to accommodate over 600 students from Pre-K through 8th grade. The building is designed with brick, metal panel, and curtain wall glass systems on a structural steel frame. The building is designed with a three-story classroom wing along Atwood Road containing 26 classrooms and a two-story structure along Kenmore Road to house the gymnatorium, full-service kitchen, cafeteria, IMC, Maker's Space, Innovation Lab, as well as Music, and Health classrooms. The two wings of the building are connected by a three-story open structure. The $62.1 Million project is designed to achieve LEED Gold certification. Mungro now attents Central High School and said she will apply to New York University to study biochemistry for a planned career as a biomedical engineer.

Folks —

I am about to step on stage at the Democratic National Convention to talk about Donald Trump’s extreme Project 2025 agenda and how fired up we are to elect Kamala Harris and Tim Walz on Election Day.

Project 2025 lays out Donald Trump’s dangerous plan should he win the presidency. He wants to rip away reproductive freedom nationwide, end civil rights protections for LGBTQ+ Americans, fire government employees who put loyalty to their country before Donald Trump, terminate the Affordable Care Act, increase everyday costs for working families, and more.

If Donald Trump gets his way, he would fundamentally change the way our government works, impacting our national security, our economy, our freedoms, and our future.

From my time serving in the Army and now to serving Colorado in Congress, I have never stopped fighting against extremism. I’m not about to stop now.

I’m going to spend the next 3 months doing everything in my power to stop the extreme Project 2025 agenda by defeating Donald Trump at the ballot box, flipping the House majority, and supporting a new generation of political leaders who share our values — but I need you with me.

In 2015, my Democratic opponent, **_Jon Tester, recruited Kamala Harris to run for the Senate._** But now that she’s his party’s presidential nominee, he’s refusing to endorse her publicly and is skipping the DNC.

**That’s fishy...**

**Could it be because he’s the most vulnerable incumbent running for reelection?**

**Could it be because he's voted 95% of the time for Joe Biden and Kamala Harris' radical agenda of open borders and reckless spending?**

**Or could Jon Tester be hiding from the press and skipping his party’s most crucial confab in the last four years because Kamala Harris is like Kryptonite to Montana voters? **

Though Tester believes he’s being inconspicuous, his motives couldn’t be clearer: **he wants to hide the policies he supports and the candidates he has hitched his wagon to in the past because they’re wildly out of step with everyday Americans.**

**There are 76 days left in this race** , and we need you on board. We only need to flip ONE SEAT to win the Senate majority, and Montana is our best shot.

**BREAKING: Vice President Kamala Harris to accept Democratic Nomination for President tonight!**

_VP Harris is the first woman Vice President, first Black Vice President, and the first South Asian Vice President, amongst many other firsts!_

Tonight, she’s going to shatter __even more__ glass ceilings when she formally accepts the Democratic nomination for president!

We’re so proud of her and all of the hard work she had to do to get to this point, _so we’re sending a letter congratulating her for this historic achievement._

[**URGENT: Sign our letter to congratulate VP Kamala Harris before she gets on stage! »**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/48947?t=7&akid=21915%2E4449941%2EzJN_Cr) | TO: Vice President Kamala Harris
FROM: A Proud Democrat

Dear VP Kamala Harris,

First and foremost, CONGRATULATIONS!!!

**_Americans all across the country are ecstatic that you’ve been chosen to be the Democratic nominee for president._**

The MAGA GOP has been attacking you relentlessly – _spreading disgusting lies and damaging misinformation._

But from the moment President Biden decided to end his campaign, you hit the ground running and have been working around the clock to fight back!

We’re so grateful for all of the work you’ve done as Vice President and we’re behind you 100% in the fight to win the presidency and prevent a MAGA takeover of our country. [**That’s why I’m signing this letter to congratulate you for being selected and chipping in $7 to Fight for Reform to elect state and local Democrats who will fight to protect our democracy! »**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/48947?t=8&akid=21915%2E4449941%2EzJN_Cr) | [SIGN OUR CONGRATULATIONS LETTER NOW »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/48947?t=9&akid=21915%2E4449941%2EzJN_Cr)
---
__x A Proud Democrat__
Thank you!

subject: DNC to Palestinians – “We’re speaking!”
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jill Stein for President 2024
body:
The DNC is silencing anti-genocide voices

| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=no_palestinian_speakers_at_dnc&n=1)
---
Peter, It’s official – the anti-Democratic Party has refused to allow even one member of the Uncommitted movement a speaking spot at the DNC. As one representative at a sit-in staged in front of the DNC convention said: "We came here to actually push for an arms embargo, to push for a permanent and immediate ceasefire, not to just get a person up here on stage giving a vetted speech, **_but they can't even give us that."_** The dirty Dems are content to force their synthetic “joy” down our throats while not allowing their tightly produced convention to be brought down by any talk of the ongoing genocide of the people of Gaza. And outside the convention, where they can’t put a muzzle on the voices of those who are demanding an end to this carnage, delegates put their fingers in their ears and even ridiculed those who were calling out the names of the children who have been massacred by U.S. supplied bombs. Of course, it was their hand-picked candidate, Kamala Harris, who set the tone for their hostile response when she angrily berated anti-genocide protesters at a rally in Michigan last month: **_“If you want Donald Trump to win, then say that. Otherwise, I’m speaking.”_** Contrast this to Jill’s rally last week, where she introduced her powerful running mate, Butch Ware, to her supporters. Jill and Butch aren’t merely giving a speaking spot to the voices of strong advocates against the subjugation, occupation, and genocide of the Palestinian people; they’re centering their voices:
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/dnc?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=no_palestinian_speakers_at_dnc&n=2 "WATCH STEIN/WARE ENDORSERS VIDEO: TO DARE") [WATCH STEIN/WARE ENDORSERS VIDEO: TO DARE](https://www.jillstein2024.com/dnc?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=no_palestinian_speakers_at_dnc&n=2)
---
Jill and Butch are committed to ending this carnage on day one of their administration. They will enforce an arms embargo against Israel until the genocide and the occupation is ended. _**[Can you donate today to help amplify the only campaign with a path to the White House that will never silence the voices of those who are demanding we stop supplying the weapons that are tearing the children of Gaza apart?](https://www.jillstein2024.com/dnc?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=no_palestinian_speakers_at_dnc&n=3)**_
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/dnc?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=no_palestinian_speakers_at_dnc&n=4 "DONATE NOW") [DONATE NOW](https://www.jillstein2024.com/dnc?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=no_palestinian_speakers_at_dnc&n=4)
---
We ask everyone calling for an immediate and permanent ceasefire and an arms embargo against Israel to join us in supporting Stein/Ware, the only anti-genocide, pro-worker, pro-planet campaign that can win the White House and bring about the transformative change we need. As Gaza goes, we all go.
In solidarity and gratitude, Team Stein/Ware 2024

I'm a former congressman from Illinois. And I'm a proud conservative. Seven years ago, the GOP swore total allegiance to Donald Trump's cult of personality. I refused to play along then, and I refuse to play along now. Today, I will tell the Democratic National Convention that I'm a Republican for Kamala Harris. Look, I took an oath to uphold our Constitution. I promised my constituents I would defend our democracy. I don't pledge my allegiance to Donald Trump, and I never will. | If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | | | | | I remember what drew me to the Republican Party. It wasn't spinelessness. It wasn't cowardice. The Republican Party that I grew up in projected a strong vision for America. But today, my former colleagues deny the brutal truth about January 6. They parrot the lies of a mob leader who called for "termination" of the Constitution. They are actively supporting someone who admits he'll be a dictator on "day one" back in office. Seriously, we as Republicans have to stop deluding ourselves. Trump doesn't care about us. He doesn't care about our country. He only cares about himself, and he will do or say anything to retake power. And I for one don't trust him to ever give it up if he gets the chance. I'll tell you what, if you want a leader with a strong vision for moving America forward, that leader is Vice President Harris. I certainly don't agree with the Vice President about everything, but I fully trust her to tell the truth, to protect our freedoms, and to strengthen our alliances. There's absolutely nothing more important than our democracy, which is why I have to ask: I'll close with this: When I look into my son Christian's eyes, I don't want to feel shame. I don't want to feel regret. I want to feel hope. I want to tell him I played a part in making history in 2024, helping to elect Kamala Harris as our President and defeat Donald Trump. Thank you for taking a stand in this election, Adam Adam Kinzinger Fmr. U.S. Congressman, IL-16 | | | ---|---|---

subject: $26.83 doesn’t seem like a lot
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Josh Hawley Victory Committee
body:
| | | Peter,

Unlike my opponent, my campaign isn’t fueled by Hollywood celebrities. The very core of this campaign is grassroots patriots like you.

During my speech tonight, I had the honor of sharing a little bit about my
family.

My mother was a teenager when I was born and she struggled with addiction.
I never met my father.

But I had two incredible grandparents who stepped in and raised me.
Everything I know, I learned from them.

In every way a child needs, my grandparents were there for me. As they
grew older, it was my privilege to be there for them.

So, when I work to protect Medicare and Social Security, I do it with the
personal knowledge of what those big programs meant in small but deeply
meaningful ways to my grandparents.

I know what they mean for your parents and grandparents.

But let’s be clear: That is all at risk today.

Right-wing extremists like Donald Trump and my opponent, Eric Hovde, want
to bring us back in time. If they had it their way, they’d cut Social

Trump wrapped an event in Arizona earlier today. Now, I’m about to go on at the Democratic National Convention in just a bit, and I’m going to make the case against Kari Lake and Trump.

Peter, there’s a lot going on right now. I know it’s a crazy time, but please: this will only take a minute.
Trump wrapped an event in Arizona earlier today. Now, I’m about to go on at the Democratic National Convention in just a bit, and I’m going to make the case against Kari Lake and Trump.
On their own, they’re dangerous enough. Together they’ve done incalculable damage to our democracy. To women’s rights. To basic decency. I’ve had enough.
They think they’re going to win, and I won’t lie to you... they’ve got a real chance. Right now, it’s a jump ball. 50-50. Arizona could go either way — and my home state could determine the whole election.
So, before I go up there and make my speech, please:
